entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, I did my best for you Shiho.[n]I'll see if it'll payoff tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not just me. There're other people that[n]fought for you too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you remember Sakamoto? The[n]one from the track team?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And that transfer student that everyone's[n]talking about.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *chuckle* Like you said, he wasn't a[n]bad person at all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You sure know how to figure a person[n]out. I'm so proud to have you as my[n]best friend.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Um. I want to formally apologize to you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I knew you weren't happy... I noticed it,[n]but I didn't even try listening to you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't just end it like this. There's no[n]way...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm going to go now... I'll see you[n]tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm sorry...[n]I don't know what else to say, Suzui.
